01 Profile

I build the team, own the architecture, and get it into production.

I'm Evan Borden, Manager of Engineering at Razorfish, a martech agency, based in Charlotte, NC. I lead the people and the plan behind client teams — hiring, staffing and resourcing development and QA engineers across the US, India and Costa Rica — and own the architecture those teams build, most recently Adobe Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer work in healthcare under HIPAA.

Underneath that is a hands-on engineering background, from enterprise WordPress and Adobe Experience Manager to the wider Adobe cloud stack, and I use AI tooling in my own day-to-day work.

03 Leadership

People, plan and architecture.

The job has two halves: the people and the plan behind a team, and the architecture that team builds. This is how I handle both.

01

Hiring & interviewing

Run staffing and interviews for development and quality assurance roles across experience levels and role types, including hiring my own successor on Disney Rewards.

02

Global talent sourcing

Work directly with the people in charge of staffing to find qualified engineers in Costa Rica and India, and fill project roles from both the internal bench and external candidates.

03

Resource planning & margin

Partner with project managers to refine resource start and end dates, understand role rates and cost, and adjust the staffing mix to protect margin.

04

Account leadership

Comfortable running more than one account at once, and trusted with the ones that matter. Technology leadership handed me Labcorp to lead it to success, and I still do. I work across teams and directly with the client, not only with my own engineers.

05

Architecture governance

Take architecture recommendations through client architecture review boards, vetting each one against the wider enterprise infrastructure it has to live in.

06

Security & HIPAA

Identify and weigh every data path in an architecture for security concerns and PHI exposure, so healthcare builds meet HIPAA by design rather than by audit.

07

Pre-sales & scoping

Contribute directly to statements of work, read RFPs, and vet technical requirements and levels of effort with the teams who will build it. Then build the slide decks, live demos and discovery documentation that frame the work.

08

Advocacy & growth

Surface engineers' contributions to leadership and make the case for their promotions. Partner daily with VP+ technical leaders.

09

Standards & practices

Streamlined teams onto an agreed set of coding conventions, naming and formatting rules, so the codebase stays consistent, reviewable and easy to hand off.

10

AI-augmented delivery

Fully up to speed with Claude, ChatGPT and other models as working tools: drafting architecture documents, writing Confluence documentation against real codebases, automating Jira ticket resolution, and building my own tools that turn out Word documents, Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint decks.
